definitions.full: H8506. token I. תֹּ֫כֶן noun masculine Ezek 45:11 measurement ; — construct ׳ת לְבֵנִים Exod 5:18 (J) the measurement , tale, of bricks ; absolute Ezek 45:11 capacity (of ephah and bath).
